narrative.overview: The network is dark water; Strandgut is what the night tide leaves on the shore. The canvas is deep water navy, the tiles are panes of tinted glass, and a single amber lamp marks everything you can touch. The voice is a quiet maritime workshop: weathered, warm-utilitarian, unhurried; surfaces are translucent layers of beach bone over the photographic ground, so the sea light is always faintly present behind the work.
keyCharacteristics: Deep water navy ground, beach-bone text, one amber voice.
Depth from layered translucency (glass), not from stacked shadows.
Tactile and quiet: panes you can press, presses you can feel.
Square service tiles on a centered auto-fit grid; everything else is a hairline-bordered pane.
Motion is short, purposeful, and settles — one deliberate bounce, everywhere else smooth decay.

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: Amber marks only what is actionable or active — buttons, focus, the checked switch, scan progress, drag targets. It never decorates.

rules.name: The Tinted Glass Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are beach-bone translucency over the ground (7% at rest, 12% hovered), never opaque grey fills; the photographic ground must stay faintly visible through them.

rules.name: The Status Earns Color Rule
rules.body: Kelp green and terracotta appear only where a real state exists (reachable, error); never for emphasis or decoration.

rules.name: The One Canvas Rule
rules.body: The painted page background is the token value (--color-surface-canvas); there is exactly one night blue. A second hardcoded navy under the photo drifts from the palette and silently changes every contrast calculation.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Grotesk speaks, Mono records: prose in Hanken Grotesk, addresses/numbers/identifiers/provenance in JetBrains Mono.

rules.name: The One Step Rule
rules.body: Headings move in one step from body (1.25rem vs 1rem); hierarchy comes from weight and spacing, not a size ladder. 1.375rem is the largest text on any screen.

rules.name: The Glass Panes Rule
rules.body: Depth is translucency plus blur; shadows are reserved for floating panes and hover lift.

rules.name: The Light From Above Rule
rules.body: Every glass edge carries its inset top highlight; never simulate light from below or the sides.

rules.name: The Reading Surface Rule
rules.body: Copy that sits on the photographic ground gets its own surface: a tinted-glass pane, or the header/footer veil. Never rely on the global photo scrim to make text legible.

rules.name: The Square Find Rule
rules.body: A service always lands as a square; its icon scales inside, the tile never changes aspect to fit content.

rules.name: The One Bounce Rule
rules.body: The pill-switch thumb is the single legitimate bounce in the system; every other transition decays smoothly.

rules.name: The Keep It Short Rule
rules.body: Motion is <= 0.3s and animates only transform, opacity, and background color — never layout properties.

dos: Do keep the canvas Deep Water Navy (#0a1628) and text Beach Bone (#e8e0d8); every new pane is a translucency of the same bone, not a new grey.
Do hold amber to interactive and active states (The One Lamp Rule), including 2px focus outlines with 2-3px offset.
Do build service entries as square tiles on the auto-fit 160px shelf; let the icon scale, not the tile.
Do put addresses, ports, identifiers, and credits in JetBrains Mono at 0.8125rem.
Do keep motion <= 0.3s on transform/opacity, keep wash-ashore for first paint, and respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Do respect the existing fallbacks: forced-colors, reduced-transparency (glass degrades to solid navy), and print.
Do give text on the photograph its own pane or veil (The Reading Surface Rule) and keep every text/ground pair at AA or better.
donts: Don't fill surfaces with opaque greys or remove backdrop blur without the reduced-transparency fallback.
Don't add resting drop shadows to tiles; they are glass at rest and only lift on hover.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing anywhere but the pill-switch thumb (The One Bounce Rule).
Don't tint headings, borders, or icons in Tide Amber; if it is not actionable or active, it is neutral.
Don't introduce a display-size headline or a third type family.
Don't use Kelp Green or Terracotta for anything without a reachable/error meaning.
Don't introduce a second canvas colour or place body copy straight on the photo ground.
